product.name: ACH Payments
product.description: API to originate ACH credits and debits with validation, same-day processing, and automatic return correlation.

product.name: Bank Accounts
product.description: API to create and manage flexible bank accounts with unlimited account numbers and versatile account structures.

product.name: Cards
product.description: API to issue custom physical and virtual cards with real-time authorization and direct Visa network integration.

product.name: Checks
product.description: API to send branded checks globally and deposit checks via API or dashboard.

product.name: Wires
product.description: API to send wire transfers anytime via Fedwire with support for reversals and detailed tracking.

product.name: Real-Time Payments
product.description: API to send and receive real-time payments to most major banks within seconds.
